spans.s: aṃśa, a small territorial unit (Ep. Ind., Vol. XV, p. 297, text line 26).
Aṃśa-bṛhadbhogika (IE 8-3; EI 28), probably, the shareholder of a big jāgīr. See Bhāgika.
aṃśa-gaṇa (EI 33); a class of metres; cf. mātrā-gaṇa.
Aṃśapati (EI 30), co-sharer of a gift land.
aṃśuka-bhāṇḍāra-karaṇa, cf. karaṇa (LP); the department of clothes.
